title: Saturn Super Vol. 7
native_title: サターン・スーパー Ｖｏｌ．７
overview:
Saturn Super Vol. 7 is a Japanese demo disc packaged with issue 7 of Takarajimasha's Saturn Super magazine. Discs in the series carry playable demos and video footage of Saturn games.

This volume includes video footage of Arthur to Astaroth no Nazomakaimura: Incredible Toons.
